_error_type_asc._comment: Empirically derived from dataset — dominant ASC topics per AuditBench error type. Used as citation fallback when concept-level ASC is unavailable.

missing row.rationale: A missing row omits a required line item. ASC 230 governs completeness of CF; ASC 210 governs BS completeness.

numerical error.rationale: A wrong value misrepresents a balance. ASC 310/330 govern measurement of specific asset classes.

redundant row.rationale: An extra row inflates a section total. ASC 210-10-50-1 prohibits redundant disclosures.

misclassification.rationale: A row placed in the wrong section violates classification rules. ASC 210-10-45-1 defines current vs non-current.

_asc_titles._comment: Human-readable titles for each ASC topic used in this project.
